$comment: GOVERNED DEFAULTS - single source of truth for the Bid Turnover Decision Engine. Human-readable spec: ../decision-engine/SPEC.md. Changes require the process in ../governance/GOVERNANCE.md.

recipients.note: Ryan, Veston, and estimating3 are always on the internal turnover email. Verify ryan@ / veston@ addresses against Outlook contacts on first production send; correct in this file, not in prompts.

closing_line: Please reply all when the Manual J is complete and again when the bid is complete.

production_default.system: Carrier production equipment, builder standard production configuration
production_default.outdoor_unit: Carrier production-series condenser / heat pump per builder standard
production_default.indoor_unit: Matching Carrier air handler or furnace/coil per builder standard
production_default.staging: Single-speed unless the Builder Profile specifies otherwise

custom_default.system: Lennox EL19KPV non-communicating variable-speed heat pump

equipment.uncertain_new_builder_rule: When a new builder cannot be classified production vs custom, use the Ryan OS custom default and flag the assumption. Never delay the turnover for classification.

gross_margin.blank_allowed_only_when: The Builder Profile sets requires_ryan_margin_approval = true, or governance explicitly requires Ryan approval for this builder.
gross_margin.note: A Builder Profile gross_margin value always overrides these defaults. Production builders under contract routinely run below 35% - that number lives in the profile, not here.

decision_order.source: Explicit builder instruction in the email
Ryan OS default (one system per floor)

system_count.mandatory_note: System count is a starting assumption. The Manual J may change the final design - estimator to flag any change before the bid is finalized.

always_include.label: Dehumidifier option(s)
always_include.default_text: Price a whole-home dehumidifier as a separate line-item option (not in base).

always_include.label: Decorative grille options
always_include.default_text: Price decorative / linear grille upgrade as a separate line-item option.

always_include.label: Fresh air assumptions
always_include.default_text: Assume code-minimum mechanical fresh air (ASHRAE 62.2) via ducted fresh air intake with motorized damper, unless plans or builder specify an ERV/HRV.

always_include.label: Exhaust fan options where applicable
always_include.default_text: Include bath exhaust fans per plan fixture count. Price an upgraded/quiet fan option where applicable.

always_include.label: Permit assumptions
always_include.default_text: Include a standard permit allowance. Confirm jurisdiction before the bid is finalized.

always_include.label: Design concern flag-back
always_include.default_text: Estimator: flag any design concerns (equipment fit, duct routing, return path, zoning, clearances) to Ryan BEFORE the final bid goes out.

pricing_profiles.$comment: Named pricing profiles. They reference a gross_margin key rather than restating the number - duplicating a governed value is how defaults drift. Resolve the number through gross_margin[margin_key].

existing_builder_standard.label: Existing Builder Standard
existing_builder_standard.use_when: A builder we already work with, where no contracted margin is recorded in the Builder Profile.

new_builder_standard.label: New Builder Standard
new_builder_standard.use_when: First project with a builder. Revisit the margin once the relationship is established.

homeowner_direct.label: Homeowner / Direct
homeowner_direct.use_when: Homeowner or one-time direct customer with no builder in the middle.

profile_proposal.$comment: Phase 2. When no Builder Profile exists, the Orchestrator presents a governed recommendation rather than an open question. These signals rank the classification candidates.
profile_proposal.note: The recommendation is always actionable. Ryan approves for this project only, creates a Builder Profile from it, or overrides - he never builds it from scratch.

manual_j_defaults.house_direction: Use plot plan if available; if not, assume worst-case orientation
manual_j_defaults.note: Manual J envelope defaults carry over from the WCS bid-request standard. They are LOW-risk assumptions - the load calc is re-run if the builder supplies real specs.

definitions.HIGH: Confirmed for THIS builder / THIS project from an authoritative source: Builder Profile, explicit written builder instruction, or mechanical plans.
definitions.MEDIUM: A governed Ryan OS default or an AI plan reading that reliably applies to this class of project, but is not confirmed for this specific project.
definitions.LOW: Unconfirmed external fact or a guess used only to avoid delaying work. Always appears under Known Unknowns.

escalation.principle: Ryan is interrupted only when meaningful business judgment is required. Everything else is a flag inside the email, not a stop.

hard_stops.reason: Builder Profile requires Ryan approval for gross margin.
Builder is flagged in the Builder Library (do-not-bid, credit hold, open pricing dispute).
Project type is outside the governed residential new-construction scope (commercial, multifamily, geothermal, hydronic/radiant, VRF, or a replacement/retrofit with unknown existing conditions).
The builder's written instruction materially contradicts the Builder Profile on equipment or margin.

never_a_hard_stop: Missing plans or attachments - send the turnover and request the plans in parallel.
Unknown story count or square footage.
New builder that cannot be classified production vs custom.
Rush deadline - mark the subject RUSH and send.
